title: Horology and instrument making
summary: Clocks, chronometers, orreries and any instrument that measures relation rather than prediction.

title: Joinery and door making
summary: Doors, frames and thresholds. Includes work on doors that open for knowing.

title: Stonemasonry
summary: Stone that must already have been in place. Civic, station and always-has-been work.

title: Weaving (timeline)
licence: Class W, or A in the first year
summary: Joining, dividing and repairing a thread of hours. Unsupervised century-holding is not in scope for apprentices.

title: Records, binding and clerical craft
summary: Minutes, catalogue marks, binding of contradictory papers, and the public register.

title: Oral history
summary: Testimony taken in the present and deposited for a year that can receive it.

title: Film processing and projection
summary: Plates, cans, embargo years and the remembering of events that have not yet happened.

title: Cartography and unplaced hours
summary: Maps of lights that have an hour but no address. Surveying of unstable chronology.

title: Metalwork and smithing
summary: Ironmongery for doors, instruments and station fittings. Includes work that must not turn for an unlicensed hand.

title: Allocations (civil service)
summary: Scheme administration. This is not a charged craft. It is the desk that licences the others.
